name: kimi_k3_latent_down_online_quant
changes: routed_expert_down_proj takes the online quantization config instead of quant_config=None (vllm-k3-latent-down-online.patch). Checkpoint weights are BF16; ATOM 6611 quantizes the same layers to MXFP4 at load time

No online config, or one whose ignore/targets do not select the layer, keeps it BF16 (UnquantizedLinearMethod). routed_expert_up_proj stays BF16: ROCmLatentMoERunner reads its weight for the sharded addmm tail
